description: The CDFIs, low-income credit unions, SBA microloan intermediaries, and ITIN-friendly national nonprofits serving a US county — the lenders that say yes when a bank says no. By lane (business, home, personal), in English or Spanish. Splits institutions headquartered in the county from those with only a walk-in branch there; a county with no door at all is answered honestly with the state tier. Every record names its federal source and vintage. Public federal data; nobody pays to be listed; no borrower information is asked or taken.

county.description: US county name, e.g. 'Harris County'. A city name also works and resolves to its county ('Houston' → Harris County).

itin.description: true when the borrower has an ITIN and no SSN — the answer leads with verified ITIN-friendly options

lane.description: 'business', 'home', or 'personal' — plain words and Spanish work too ('negocio', 'vivienda', 'préstamo personal')

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'Texas' or 'TX'

types.description: Optional: keep only these kinds of institution (any match). Omit for all.

name: origen_financing_lookup
title: Look up community lenders for a US county
